messages:
maya: Heads-up: Lumina Therapeutics verbally agreed to a customer profile. We booked the interview for Thu 4/14 at 9:30am PT. Need: legal approval path for quotes, confirmation of metrics, recording owner, and lead routing for follow-up demo invites.

jon: I can handle recording + deliverables. Prefer Zoom cloud + local audio. Will schedule a 10-min tech check at 9:15.

reena: Draft quote (pls review):
```
"Lumina scaled our LLM inference to production in 5 weeks, cutting per-request cost ~55% and improving median latency by 40% with Redwood Dedicated."
```

harry: CS note: I need to validate the 55% cost figure with the ops team. If it's approximate we should say "~55%" or round to 50/60. Also confirm theyre comfortable with the wording.

maya: @reena can you confirm if Lumina already provided headshots and logo? Design needs hi-res by Tue for thumbnails and social cuts.

toni: Design here : need transparent logo (svg/png), 2x headshots, brand color hex codes, and access to any demo slides. I'll make 3 thumbnail options and a 30s social cut.

mike: Legal: if we publish exact figures we require written approval from Lumina legal. Also flag any mention of "clinical" or patient scenarios  avoid PHI. I can do a quick review if CS posts the final numbers and customer attestation.

jon: Recording checklist: 1) Host and guest on wired headphones; 2) Local audio + cloud; 3) Record slides as PDF; 4) Backup to GDrive; 5) Otter.ai transcript and upload to /marketing/assets/lumina/raw/

reena: Also recommending 3 pull-quote lengths (social short, blog medium, featured long). I'll draft variants once numbers are final.

harry: I'll confirm the cost/latency numbers by Tue 10:30am and post CS approval here.

mike: Once CS confirms, I'll send the legal sign-off via this thread and PM Lumina legal for written approval.

maya: Lead routing: SDR wants demo signups to go to campaign=lumina_q2 and queue east-sdr. @jon can you add UTMs to the post link?

jon: Yep will append utm_campaign=lumina_q2 and hand off to SDR ops with the SFDC campaign id.

maya: Timeline snapshot:
- Tue 10:30am: CS posts final numbers
- Tue EOD: design assets uploaded
- Thu 9:15am: tech check
- Thu 9:30am: recording
- Fri: publish blog + social + add webinar mention + route leads

reena: I'll post the three quote variants after CS confirms. Also drafting a 2-line webinar teaser for the blog.

mike: Legal will sign after CS confirmation. Will log approval in this thread.

maya: Thanks all  Ill create the rehearsal invite and add a checklist to #launches. :rocket:
